 Author’s Note: This morning, we are adding ZEC to Risk Management Coverage. Privacy sits as one the lone BULLISH TRENDS in Crypto and we’ve been profiling the narrative & price rotation momentum around the meta for the past ~6 weeks. 

 The high-level narrative framing is relatively straightforward and adheres to some version of the following …. 

 BTC has been captured by Tradfi, never implemented the level of privacy Satoshi aspired to and has lost its cypherpunk ethos → at a time when the onslaught against privacy is accelerating with legacy finance and sovereigns both baby stepping advocation for mandatory digital ID, laying the foundation for full surveillance state capacity. 

 Full BTC adoption & regulatory capture = BTC has lost a lot of its risk premium and most of its original ideological/iconoclastic mojo. The dog caught the car and is not anti-establishment, didn’t creatively destruct & replace the legacy financial system & has no psycho-emotional-ideological anchor to rally around or fight for. 

 Does the zeitgeist & price momentum around privacy persist or wilt like most shiny crypto things? We don’t know (precedent suggests the latter). But simple, high gravity ideas do carry a higher relative probability of sustainably accreting both followers & capital.
